programs=base/'programs'; programs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            color = grid[r][c]
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = set()
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.add((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    p = (y + dy, x + dx)
                    if (0 <= p[0] < h and 0 <= p[1] < w and
                            p not in seen and grid[p[0]][p[1]] == color):
                        seen.add(p)
                        stack.append(p)
            r0 = min(y for y, x in cells)
            r1 = max(y for y, x in cells)
            c0 = min(x for y, x in cells)
            c1 = max(x for y, x in cells)
            border = {(y, x) for y in range(r0, r1 + 1) for x in range(c0, c1 + 1)
                      if y in (r0, r1) or x in (c0, c1)}
            is_frame = border <= cells
            objects.append((color, cells, is_frame, r0, r1, c0, c1))

    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    for frame in (True, False):
        group = [o for o in objects if o[2] == frame]
        group.sort(key=lambda o: o[3] if frame else -o[4])
        placed = set()
        for color, cells, _, r0, r1, c0, c1 in group:
            dy = 0
            if frame:
                while min(y + dy for y, x in cells) > 0 and not any(
                        (y + dy - 1, x) in placed for y, x in cells):
                    dy -= 1
            else:
                while max(y + dy for y, x in cells) < h - 1 and not any(
                        (y + dy + 1, x) in placed for y, x in cells):
                    dy += 1
            moved = {(y + dy, x) for y, x in cells}
            for y, x in moved:
                out[y][x] = color
            placed.update(moved)
    return out
'''
